props.title: ulams — the open, AI-native LMS
props.description: Courses that stay true to their sources: an open-source, AI-native LMS with cited generation, a site per customer and standards built in.

props.title: Courses built from your docs. Every claim cited.
props.subtitle: AI drafts lessons from your material. You review every change before publishing.

diff.ariaLabel: Example course draft grounded in a source document, ready for author review
diff.title: Incident response
diff.note: Example draft. The author reviews every change before publishing.

props.title: Six academies, one platform
props.intro: Each demo is a separate tenant with its own theme, course and data, running on the same ulams install. Open it as a learner or step into its admin.
props.note: Demos reset every hour. No sign-up: you are logged in automatically.

props.title: Courses people can trust.
props.intro: Know what shaped each lesson, where each customer learns and how your content fits the systems you already use.

items.title: Cited by design
items.text: Every AI-generated element cites the source fragment it is based on. AI proposes; the author reviews and approves.

items.title: A site per customer
items.text: Each tenant gets its own subdomain, theme and isolated database for customer and partner learning.

items.title: Standards first
items.text: H5P, SCORM, cmi5 and xAPI work today. See the standards below for integration details.

props.title: Manage your academy from Claude, Claude Code or your terminal
props.intro: Use Claude Code, Claude or any MCP-compatible agent, the command line or the API. The studio is one way to run ulams, not the only one.
props.valueLine: One platform, every interface your team already works in.
props.legal: Claude and Claude Code are products of Anthropic. ulams is independent and not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

props.title: Delivered anywhere
props.intro: Standards over lock-in: bring existing packages, track learning anywhere, integrate through the API.

props.title: How ulams compares
props.intro: ulams is built for developers and AI agents first: courses are managed through the REST API and the TypeScript SDK, with an agent-first CLI and MCP server coming. Compared with open-source and creator platforms, and with enterprise suites; our roadmap items are marked Coming.

final.intro: What buyers usually weigh, product by product, in two groups: open-source and creator platforms, and enterprise suites.

props.title: Your servers. Your data.
props.text: The core is MIT-licensed and runs with Docker Compose: the API, the admin, this frontend and the H5P service. Paid cloud and enterprise features come on top, never instead.
